requirements.title: Themes in the Black Experience
requirements.sourceText: Themes in the Black Experience: AFS 101 - Themes in the Black Experience I 3 credits; AFS 102 - Themes in the Black Experience II 3 credits

requirements.title: One course from each area

rule.text: One course from each of the following areas: Africana Studies in the Humanities; Africana Studies in the Social Sciences; The African-American Experience; The Global African Experience. See the Africana Studies, BA page to review courses available in these areas.
rule.reason: The area course lists are on a different catalog page and are not included here, so one course per area cannot be checked against this page.

requirements.sourceText: One course from each of the following areas: Africana Studies in the Humanities; Africana Studies in the Social Sciences; The African-American Experience; The Global African Experience. See the Africana Studies, BA page to review courses available in these areas.

requirements.title: Additional Requirements

rules.text: One additional upper-division course selected from one of the areas listed in requirement 2
rules.reason: The area course lists are on the Africana Studies, BA page and are not included here, so the upper-division course cannot be checked against them.

rules.manualCheck: Must be taken in the junior or senior year.

requirements.sourceText: One additional upper-division course selected from one of the areas listed in requirement 2 OR Three credits in AFH 447 or AFS 447 Readings in Africana Studies or AFH 487 or AFS 487 Research in Africana Studies taken in the junior or senior year.

requirements.label: credits
requirements.title: Minor credit totals

rule.text: Completion of the minor requires 21 credits, including 12 upper-division credits.
rule.reason: Program-wide credit totals and an upper-division credit minimum are not a rule type the engine supports.

requirements.sourceText: Completion of the minor requires 21 credits, including 12 upper-division credits.

policies.sourceText: All courses offered for the minor, except those graded S/U, must be passed with a letter grade of C or higher.

notes.text: The minor is intended for students exploring the Black experience in relation to their own major field of study. Courses for the areas in requirement 2 are listed on the Africana Studies, BA page.
Courses graded S/U are exempt from the letter grade of C or higher requirement.
